description: Oncologist concordance labels. Biomarker from the patient's cBioPortal sequencing record, drug from the patient's GDC clinical record, joined on patient id only. Neither field is derived from the other.

gene_panel.citation: Cheng DT et al. J Mol Diagn 2015;17:251. doi:10.1016/j.jmoldx.2014.12.006

primary_alteration_rule: Of the alterations the patient actually carries, the one in the gene altered in the most patients in that cohort. Computed from sequencing data alone; no drug and no evidence-table lookup takes part. The full list is kept in 'biomarkers'.

oncologist_recommended_drugs: Recombinant PRAME Protein Plus AS15 Adjuvant GSK2302025A
Multi-glioblastoma-peptide-targeting Autologous Dendritic Cell Vaccine ICT-107
Glutathione Pegylated Liposomal Doxorubicin Hydrochloride Formulation 2B3-101
